roles.title: Deck lead / orchestrator
responsibilities: normalize the user request and authority boundaries
create the run workspace
assign bounded specialist tasks
resolve conflicts and assemble deck.json
generate formats and make final release decision

roles.title: Narrative and layout architect
responsibilities: extract the argument and audience decision
design the slide sequence
route each slide to a registered layout
write realistic copy within layout budgets

roles.title: Brand and visual asset curator
responsibilities: inventory supplied logos and images
map assets to registered image slots
record crop, alt text, provenance, and missing-asset status
select only packaged design-system icons

roles.title: Speaker notes and timing editor
responsibilities: write purpose, speaking points, and transitions for each proposed slide
avoid inventing unsupported live details
keep notes aligned with slide IDs and supplied source material

roles.title: HTML and web QA reviewer
responsibilities: run HTML preflight and inspect screenshots
report overlap, overflow, fonts, images, alignment, and background failures
write a read-only evidence report

roles.title: PPTX QA reviewer
responsibilities: render every PPTX slide
run overflow checks
inspect editability, font substitution, backgrounds, and crops
write a read-only evidence report

roles.title: PDF QA reviewer
responsibilities: render every PDF page
check page count, aspect ratio, fonts, images, and print styling
write a read-only evidence report

dependencyRules: speaker-notes-editor may start from the brief but should receive narrative.json before finalizing notes
integration starts only after narrative.json is valid and all requested planning handoffs are complete or explicitly waived
format QA starts only after the lead has generated the corresponding artifact
release starts only after every requested format has a passing QA report
